usage: Used for the idea of cooking or preparing meals at home; it sounds natural in everyday spoken Cantonese.
Often appears in contexts like family life, housework, and daily routines, especially when talking about who cooks.
Can work as a noun or a topic word, so it is common in questions about skills, hobbies, and responsibilities.
For beginner learners, it is a very useful everyday word; it is more general than specific dish names or formal cooking terms.
